Categories.value: Lion's Head|Self-published work

ImageDescription.value: SunStar has been created and built by Cape Town-based artist, Christopher Swift – founder of the Robben Island Fence Project. The installation, which will be illuminated, is highly sustainable because of its use of 4 000 strip LED lights that have been repurposed from a previous installation. Swift has previously won Spier Contemporary Arts Awards and the Michaelis Award. It is situated on Signal Hill in Cape Town in the Western Cape of South Africa

Late afternoon sun radiates on Lion's Head. As seen from my room at Bantry Bay Suite Hotel in the Bantry Bay area of Cape Town.

Lion's Head is a mountain in Cape Town, South Africa, between Table Mountain and Signal Hill. Lion's Head peaks at 669 metres (2,195 ft) above sea level. The peak forms part of a dramatic backdrop to the city of Cape Town and is part of the Table Mountain National Park.
